تستلبين (form VIII)
# تَسْتَلِبِينَ (tastalibīna) /tas.ta.li.biː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past active indicative of اِسْتَلَبَ (istalaba)
# تُسْتَلَبِينَ (tustalabīna) /tus.ta.la.biː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَلَبَ (istalaba)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
